script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: The closing line about loving a surprise invitation is generic and doesn't add a clear joke or insight.
The comparison about opening something and finding a surprise living inside is too vague to make a clear, recognizable joke.
The text says Samson did not tell his parents where the honey came from. It does not establish that they had no idea of its origin.
The text does not establish that only Samson knew about the honey. It says he did not tell his parents where it came from.
The text does not say that no one at the feast was present when Samson found the honey.
Saying she says he doesn't love her because he hasn't explained the riddle assigns a reason the text does not explicitly give.
The text says she explained the riddle to her people. It does not explicitly say she told the thirty men directly.
